{{Quote|Ki Sazen saved my people. She was only a Padawan when she came to Tas-La and slew the Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu.|The Nikto [[Chevuk]] mentions the Spine dragon of M'dweshuu|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu''' was a [[Spine dragon/Legends|spine dragon]] who was killed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ki Sazen]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Sazen killed the dragon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tas-La]], and after defeating it a [[Cult of Ki Sazen|cult]] made up of members of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Species/Legends|species]] formed around her because of the deed.<ref name="TOR" /> [[M'dweshuu]] was a [[Nova/Legends|nova]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Spine Dragon of M'dweshuu was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. The dragon was mentioned in the quest "The Cult of Ki Sazen" which took place on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and was for players of the [[Imperial Agent]] class.
